text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Bertingkat Damansara-Shah Alam) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 13 Oktober 2022.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Bertingkat

Damansara-Shah Alam yang bermula dari kilometer 0.00 Lebuh Raya Bertingkat

Damansara-Shah Alam di koordinat U -60259.819, T -1182.376 Geosentrik Datum

Malaysia (GDM2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 16.3 Persimpangan Bertingkat Penchala

di koordinat U -56978.290, T 11743.026 GDM2000 termasuklah Persimpangan

Bertingkat Puncak Perdana, Persimpangan Bertingkat Alam Suria,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Denai Alam, Plaza Tol Denai Alam, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Kg. Melayu Subang, Persimpangan Bertingkat Pinggiran Subang,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Subang 2, Persimpangan Bertingkat Lapangan Terbang

Subang, Persimpangan Bertingkat RRIM (Kwasa Damansara), Plaza Tol RRIM

(Kwasa Damansara), Persimpangan Bertingkat Surian, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Seksyen 5 Kota Damansara, Plaza Tol Kota Damansara, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Sunway Damansara, Persimpangan Bertingkat Damansara Perdana,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Penchala dan jalan-jalan sambungannya, iaitu suatu jarak

sepanjang 16.3 kilometer, diisytiharkan sebagai jalan persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (DAMANSARA-SHAH ALAM ELEVATED EXPRESSWAY)

ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads

(Damansara-Shah Alam Elevated Expressway) Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 13 October 2022.

Declaration of road to be federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Damansara-Shah Alam Elevated

Expressway commencing from kilometre 0.00 Damansara-Shah Alam Elevated

Expressway at coordinates N -60259.819, E -1182.376 Geocentric Datum

of Malaysia (GDM2000) and ending at kilometre 16.3 Penchala Interchange

at coordinates N -56978.290, E 11743.026 GDM2000 including the Puncak Perdana

Interchange, Alam Suria Interchange, Denai Alam Interchange, Denai Alam Toll Plaza,

Kg. Melayu Subang Interchange, Pinggiran Subang Interchange,

Subang 2 Interchange, Subang Airport Interchange, RRIM (Kwasa Damansara)

Interchange, RRIM (Kwasa Damansara) Toll Plaza, Surian Interchange,

Seksyen 5 Kota Damansara Interchange, Kota Damansara Toll Plaza,

Sunway Damansara Interchange, Damansara Perdana Interchange, Penchala Interchange

and its link roads, being a distance of 16.3 kilometres, is declared to be a federal road.

(2) The road declared to be federal road under subparagraph (1)

is shown on the map in the Schedule.
